newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF says real GDP to grow 1.9 pct in 1997/98.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF says real GDP to grow 1.9 pct in 1997/98.

text.p: Japan's Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Wednesday that he expects Japan to be able to achieve its forecast of 1.9 percent growth in real gross domestic product (GDP) in the next fiscal year from April 1.

"We will certainly be able to achieve growth of 2.5 percent in 1996/97. As the Economic Planning Agency minister has said, consumption is becoming solid," Mitsuzuka told a key parliamentary committee.

"Although the economy may become sluggish in the April-June period with the increase in consumption tax, we will be able to achieve 1.9 percent growth as the economy gradually recovers in the following quarters," he said.
"I believe the foundations of the Japanese economy are solid and strong," Mitsuzuka said.
